facts.title: How to compare the responses
facts.text: Compare feasible scenarios using cost, unmet demand, exclusions and constraints together. Held, recalled and ineligible lots cannot dispatch. A predictive score alone does not impose a mandatory hold. Approval must be recorded in Command against the current revision.
uncertainty: The objective selects a single allocation wave with fixed candidate trip estimates; it is not a continuous inventory ledger.
